decision: Following the user-approved Logan Corner practice (2026-10-27), menu items with no restaurant photo got labelled Wikimedia Commons illustrations.
how: Uploaded through the owner admin in the user's signed-in browser (media upload plus dish PATCH, one publication per dish). There is no restaurant.json import package for this tenant in the repo.
labelling: Each illustrative dish description is "Illustrative photo, not from this restaurant: <author>, <licence>, Wikimedia Commons." (or "(Wikimedia Commons, CC0)."); alt text "<dish> (illustrative photo)".
restaurantPhotoSearch: Bounded web search (DoorDash/Caviar listings, general search) on 2026-10-27 found no additional restaurant photos for these items; the 32 existing dish photos were already published on 2026-10-25.

notUsed.Gravy: Commons results were Indian curries or empty sauce boats.
notUsed.Crush: No usable Crush soda photo (only ads and unrelated results).
notUsed.Brisk Iced Tea: Only photo shows a green and a brown drink in glasses, no Brisk can.
notUsed.Celsius Tropical Vibe / Celsius Peach Vi: Only a different Celsius flavour can exists.
notUsed.Pure Leaf Citron / Pure Leaf Raspberry: Only a logo close-up of another Pure Leaf bottle exists.
notUsed.18 Pieces Bucket Chicken: KFC bucket photos rejected (competitor branding); a family meal of chicken and fries was used instead.
